name: ${NAME}
description: DDSP-SVC 6.3 singing voice (P5-A) in ${SLOT_DDSP} on ${EP}: the sung E2 -> D#6 sweep with vibrato (${SWEEP}, scripts/bench/singing_sweep.py) at ${SEMITONES} st (+12: E3 -> D#7 out), ${PITCH_SINGING} F0 in the singing range, the slot's preset, the voice changer's default 512-frame device block at 48 kHz and its default 35 / 70 ms output buffer (raised to the family's 70 / 140 ms minimum, as the voice changer does; P5-I0), levers auto. Offline compute, a paced run on the virtual clock (engine-added latency, underruns), the H1 simulation (GPU + CPU load, 3 s stall) and fidelity against the offline ceiling (a second instance converting the whole recording; P5-I0), scored with CREPE in the singing range. T10 against the intended notes: python scripts/bench/score_singing.py <out>/offline.output.wav ${SEMITONES} (pYIN; the bench's RMVPE analyzer reads singing above about 1 kHz an octave low). Materialized by run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile p5.
